title: Any SKY holder can force review of an Agent Artifact conflict, and the Agent gets fourteen days to cure it
content:
A.1.14.1.5 gives standing to every token holder: a SKY holder who believes an Agent Artifact conflicts with the Sky Core Atlas "may escalate their concern to the Core Facilitator via posting a 'Notice of Potential Conflict' on the Sky Forum," and upon receipt the protocol "must be initiated." Enforcement of the hierarchy is therefore not gated on the Facilitator noticing a problem, and unlike Atlas amendments it requires no delegate stake — anyone can compel a review.

The stages are tightly specified. A.1.14.1.5.1 requires the Core Facilitator to "review the merits of the claim," with discretion to investigate further. A.1.14.1.5.2 requires a formal determination either way: a finding of conflict produces an "Intent to Suspend" notice against the specific provision, while a finding of no conflict must be posted "and their reasoning in response to the Notice of Potential Conflict on the Sky Forum." A.1.14.1.5.3 then gives "the relevant Prime Agent or Prime Agent token holders fourteen (14) days to amend or clarify the Artifact provision in question in order to ameliorate the conflict," after which the Facilitator re-examines and, if unresolved, "the relevant portion of the Agent Artifact is formally invalidated."

The cure period is the design choice worth noting. Supremacy could be enforced instantly — the conflicting provision is already invalid under A.1.14.1.4 — but immediate invalidation would break an Agent's operations over what may be a drafting ambiguity. The 14 days let the Agent fix its own text, and the option to "clarify" rather than amend acknowledges that many apparent conflicts are interpretive.

Requiring reasoning on the negative finding matters as much as the positive one: it prevents dismissal by silence and builds a public record of what does and does not count as conflict.
description: A Notice of Potential Conflict triggers mandatory Core Facilitator review and a formal determination; an Intent to Suspend gives the Prime Agent 14 days before the provision is invalidated.
